name: title-snapshot-equals-boot
description: #37 Tier 2 acceptance: the input script of title-determinism, played from the title snapshot and, in a new core instance, from a fresh power-on boot through the title boot point's press script with no snapshot. Both must end at T + 732 in the same state: main RAM and picture, compared by hash inside the sandbox, reported only as match 1/0. Shares the run's one title snapshot with title-determinism.
